Its slim fit design highlights the masculine silhouette, while the colour contrasts add a modern touch. Available in over 20 colours, it is perfect to suit all styles and preferences. Contrast buttons and adjustable cuffs add character to this refined shirt. Whether for the office, a formal event or an evening with friends, this shirt will accompany you with elegance. Easy to maintain, it does not wrinkle very little, guaranteeing you a flawless look in all circumstances. Order now and add a sophisticated touch to your wardrobe.
